05 / Fix the boundary that language cannot enforce

        
Routine work can
stay deterministic
Use a capable model only where language reasoning adds value. System permissions remain mandatory.

        

          
01
Rule-based chatbots
Use pre-LLM rule-based chatbots, forms and state machines for simple bookings and updates.
Avoid low-quality models in sensitive workflows. Add an LLM only when the task needs language reasoning.

          
02
Isolate and limit access
Sensitive databases and credentials stay outside model reach. Least privilege restricts tools, records, fields and recipients.
Set rate and volume limits, including records hidden inside aggregate cells.

          
03
Filter and validate
Validate inputs; distrust retrieved instructions. Check predicates, output and recipients before dispatch.
An optional validation loop or independent decision model can review risky actions when latency, cost and operations budgets fit.

        

        
Authenticated formFixed service + permissionsPrivate databaseAuthorized user interface

        
Proposed product: a workflow and permissions broker. Defence replay remains pending.

Technical execution / repeatable protocol
Fresh-session replay

    
Choose exact model IDs, start a fresh conversation for each trial, send the same prompt 2–3 times, and check for the expected values plus a tool invocation. Store every turn, including errors.

    
Extensive exploration is documented in 1,506 combined records. This skeleton has been checked offline. Live repeat rates and mitigation replays are pending.

    

    
Offline plan

    
The script sends nothing by default. Live mode uses the existing configured key and exact available model IDs, with no provider fallback.

    
Full runnable skeleton / reproduce.py

    
Fixture prompts / fictional records only

    
Record matched / completed / errors / planned for each model and case. Two or three trials provide an initial repeat check, not a precise probability estimate.
